Build against API version v1 (current sprint S21 fact) with base path AX-18174 and error format AX-29401; the older S01-S20 api_version facts (v2..v40) are from earlier sprints and do not govern. Code in repo/api.py matches the S21 values.

Use the security team's JWT bearer tokens (RS256, 15 minute expiry) for all user traffic. Globex's request for a long-lived X-Api-Key conflicts with it and is not adopted for user traffic. Their non-interactive back-office scripts are deferred to a separate, scoped service-credential option to be designed and reviewed by security, not a long-lived key on the user API.
Reuse the Bolt Billing API S07 billing cycle (quarterly, invoiced on day 7) and the S13 API-key header (X-Core-Key) for this sprint, as recorded in team memory.

Adopt API v2 as the Acme Notes API version, per the researcher's updated api_version fact for Acme Notes API S21 (the latest one, valid from 1792183929970); it governs over the older api_version facts for earlier sprint entities.

Approve the spec: API version v2 and JWT bearer auth (RS256, 15 min expiry). The conflicting Globex long-lived API-key fact does not govern, because it is a client request and conflicts with the short-expiry requirement.
Approve the CRUD spec: API version v2 and JWT bearer (RS256, 15 min) auth are consistent; flag the unresolved conflicting Globex API-key auth fact for follow-up.
